Governance Risk Compliance

مراجعة الإدارة

A formal evaluation conducted by senior management to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of security, compliance, and risk management processes.

Definition

A formal evaluation conducted by senior management to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of security, compliance, and risk management processes.

Operational example

An annual management review is required to evaluate the performance of the information security management system and identify areas for improvement.
